name: radare2
notes: radare2 6.2.4 built natively for darwin-arm64 into local-tools/radare2 (bin, lib, share, include). test.sh passed on 2026-10-16 (9 checks: rasm2 MIPS/Thumb/PPC/SM83 disassembly, rasm2 MIPS and ARM assembly, radare2 ESIL emulation, and aaa/pdf on a self-built Thumb object when arm-none-eabi-gcc is present). The archive was not kept, so sha256 is null. The release tag 6.2.4 was confirmed on GitHub with gh. Binaries reference lib/ by absolute path inside this project.
